desc: a thick jagged lightning bolt striking straight DOWN from the top of its cell and ending in a bright crackling impact burst at its bottom end, in glowing teal-cyan with a white-hot core
motion: The lightning bolt flickers and crackles violently for a moment, then quickly breaks apart into small sparks and fades out.

desc: a violent eruption of energy bursting straight UPWARD from a short jagged crack at the bottom: tall sharp flame-like spikes in glowing crimson-pink with a white-hot core
motion: The eruption surges upward and flickers, then thins out into a few rising embers and fades out.

desc: a big round explosion seen from above: a white-hot center, a thick ring of orange-yellow fire and sharp radial flame spikes all around, with a few small rock fragments flying out
motion: The explosion expands outward as a ring of fire, then breaks into thin wisps and fades out.

desc: a burst of ghost fire: a ring of pale-gold and soft-violet spirit flames (will-o'-the-wisps) spiralling out from a white-hot center
motion: The spirit flames spiral upward and outward, then dissolve into small drifting motes of light and fade out.
